summary.en: Iran-backed suspects are accused of plotting attacks on a U.K. air base that hosts U.S. jets, while an Iran-backed trio is linked to a drone strike on the Khor Mor gas field in Iraqi Kurdistan that halted production and cut power. Iraqi security officials tied the Khor Mor attack to internal disputes, announced expanded air-defence deployments, and reported the arrest of a suspect for killing his brother in Shamamak. Iraq is sending a delegation to Lebanon after former MP Ahmed al-Alwani was found dead in Beirut, and the prime minister's aide said there is no deadline for disarming militias this year. 396 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Irans støttede mistenkte blir anklaget for å ha planlagt angrep på en britisk flybase som huser amerikanske jagerfly, mens en irans støttet trio er knyttet til et droneangrep på gassfeltet Khor Mor i irakisk Kurdistan som stoppet produksjonen og kuttet strømmen. Iraks sikkerhetsmyndigheter knyttet Khor Mor-angrepet til interne stridigheter, kunngjorde utvidet luftforsvarsutplassering, og rapporterte at en mistenkt ble arrestert for å ha drept sin bror i Shamamak. Irak sender en delegasjon til Libanon etter at tidligere stortingsrepresentant Ahmed al-Alwani ble funnet død i Beirut, og statsministerens assistent sa at det ikke er noen frist for å avlegge våpen fra militsene i år. 396 kamprelaterte dødsfall i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Iraqi conflict
background.extract: The Iraqi conflict is a series of violent events that began with the 2003 American-led invasion of Iraq and deposition of Iraqi dictator Saddam Hussein, followed by a series of conflicts including the protracted Iraq War (2003–2011), the Iraqi insurgency (2011–2013), the War in Iraq (2013–2017), and most recently, the small-scale Islamic State insurgency in 4 provinces located in Northern Iraq since 2017.
